termZh: * 网基米 -- -- 均匀 -- -- 价值
definitionZh: *webkit-meet-even-good-value 当值和最佳属性在低高范围以外,但位于相反的区域时,会给测量元素样式. 举例来说,当值高 > 低 > 最佳时适用。
sourceDefinition: The ::-webkit-meter-even-less-good-value styles the meter element when the value and the optimum attributes fall outside the low-high range, but in opposite zones. To illustrate, it applies when value high > low > optimum.
